name: Amara
desc:
Amara is a Khan NPC. She is a Centurion of the [11th Legion](faction:the_hundred_legions) and stays with her group of scouts composed of [Atra](entity:atra), [Caitus](entity:caitus), [Gaius](entity:gaius) and [Lars](entity:lars).

She also teaches you the Legion Kata fighting style after turning in a Captain's Recc obtained by assisting the 11th Legion in [Aratel Island](location:aratel_island) or in [Upper Erisia](location:upper_erisia).

Her and the 11th Scouting Legion arrived in the East from the Western Luminant to observe the conflict between [the Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) and [Etrea](faction:etrea).
additional_info:
-   If you have either Legion Kata or good reputation, she will say something along the lines of "_Good to see you again \[Name\], What brings you back to the camp?_", yet your dialogue options are still the same and she answers the same way.
-   Her hair id is 4996584513
